verdict.rationale: The evidence shows approval-oriented review: reviewing captured screenshots and video before approving a change, plan-first alignment, and PR merge in Review Hub. It also shows background cloud agents. Nothing documents a mobile or phone approval surface, or approving key decisions mid-run while agents keep working. Post-hoc change review is an adjacent capability, not this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working
